title: Marguerite and the Cover
author: Juniper Whitlock
blurb: Yara Coldharbour, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
